errors.error_description: The always block's sensitivity list includes only parallel_in but reads load inside, causing a mismatch between signals read and those listed.
Used logical AND (&&) between two vector signals (hold_mask and enable_mask), which collapses to a single-bit truth value instead of bitwise AND.
The always_comb block incompletely assigns insertion_bit (missing an else branch), inferring a latch in synthesis.
